start_google_meet_bot: start a google meet bot to join a meeting and transcribe the conversation
send_text_through_meet_bot: send text through the meet bot to speak during an active meeting session
fetch_meeting_transcript: fetch the meeting transcript with an optional limit on the number of recent messages
stop_meet_bot: stop the running google meet bot and end the active meeting session
check_meet_bot_status: check the current status of the google meet bot or ping it for health
